dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Thank you for waiting, Nam. I'm afraid there's a technical problem in your neighborhood.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈweɪtɪŋ, ˈnɑːm. aɪm əˈfreɪd ðɛrz ə ˈtɛknɪkəl ˈprɑːbləm ɪn jʊr ˈneɪbərhʊd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Oh no. Is that why I don't have a connection?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ ˈnoʊ. ɪz ðæt ˈwaɪ aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ə kəˈnɛkʃən?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Yes. Unfortunately, our engineers can't fix it today.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ʌnˈfɔːrtʃənətli, aʊr ˌɛndʒɪˈnɪrz ˈkænt ˈfɪks ɪt təˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? I need the internet for my online classes.
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? aɪ ˈniːd ði ˈɪntərnɛt fər maɪ ˌɑːnˈlaɪn ˈklæsɪz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, but I can't do anything about that. Just to check, have you tried restarting your router?
dialogue.reading: aɪm ˈsɑːri, bʌt aɪ ˈkænt ˈduː ˈɛniθɪŋ əˈbaʊt ˈðæt. ˈdʒʌst tə ˈtʃɛk, hæv juː ˈtraɪd ˌriːˈstɑːrtɪŋ jʊr ˈraʊtər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, three times. The lights are on, but there's no signal.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ˈθriː ˈtaɪmz. ðə ˈlaɪts ər ˈɑːn, bʌt ðɛrz ˈnoʊ ˈsɪɡnəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I see. Then a technician needs to check it.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. ˈðɛn ə tɛkˈnɪʃən ˈniːdz tə ˈtʃɛk ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I'm afraid all our technicians are unavailable today. Tomorrow is fully booked, too.
dialogue.reading: aɪm əˈfreɪd ˈɔːl aʊr tɛkˈnɪʃənz ər ˌʌnəˈveɪləbəl təˈdeɪ. təˈmɑːroʊ ɪz ˈfʊli ˈbʊkt, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: That's terrible! What's the earliest day?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈtɛrəbəl! ˈwʌts ði ˈɜːrliɪst ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Unfortunately, the earliest is Friday afternoon. Is that OK?
dialogue.reading: ʌnˈfɔːrtʃənətli, ði ˈɜːrliɪst ɪz ˈfraɪdeɪ ˌæftərˈnuːn. ɪz ðæt oʊˈkeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I don't have any other option, so please book Friday.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈhæv ˈɛni ˈʌðər ˈɑːpʃən, soʊ ˈpliːz ˈbʊk ˈfraɪdeɪ.
